question: Did Coefficient Giving (formerly Open Philanthropy) fund METR?

scope.included: METR's own list of funders; a third-party ledger's report on Coefficient's grants index and on ARC's 990 Schedule I; that ledger's own audit note on its rendered figure; ProPublica's summary of ARC's FY2024 finances.
scope.excluded: Grants from Coefficient to organizations METR shares people, offices or projects with, beyond the ARC spin-out transfer; donor-advised-fund donors; any judgment about influence.
scope.comparison_target: The rendered figure's 'Direct: $0' and the reading, common online, that Coefficient money reached METR, compared with what the index, the filings and METR's own page say.

exact_spans.supports: METR's named foundation funders; Coefficient and Open Philanthropy are not among them.

exact_spans.supports: Third-party report of a bounded search of Coefficient's index.

results.proposition: A third-party ledger reports no METR-named grant in Coefficient Giving's 2,911-row index snapshot of 2026-09-11, and METR's own funder list on 2026-09-14 does not name Coefficient or Open Philanthropy.
results.interpretation: Two independent absences: one in the funder's index as reported by a third party, one on the recipient's page. Neither is re-derived from the index in this docket.
results.warrant: The ledger row states the search scope and result; METR's page lists its foundation funders.

scope.dataset_or_population: Coefficient grants index snapshot and METR's funder list
scope.metric_scope: Presence of a named grant; not routing through intermediaries
scope.tool_and_retrieval_path: git clone and direct HTTPS fetch

claim_atoms.text: The index search is a third-party report; this docket has not re-run it.

results.uncertainty: The negative rests on one third party's search; absence is bounded to that snapshot and search.

results.proposition: Coefficient granted $1,515,000 to the Alignment Research Center in 2022 ($265,000 and $1,250,000), and ARC's FY2024 Form 990 Schedule I reports a $4,553,935 grant to Model Evaluation and Threat Research Inc.
results.interpretation: Money from Coefficient reached METR's parent before the spin-out, and the parent transferred assets to METR at the spin-out. This is routing through a parent, not a grant to METR.
results.warrant: The ledger rows carry the amounts and the filing line; ProPublica's ARC summary shows FY2024 expenses well above revenue, consistent with the transfer.

scope.dataset_or_population: Coefficient grants to ARC and ARC's Schedule I
scope.metric_scope: Amounts as recorded; does not trace what share of the transfer originated with Coefficient
scope.tool_and_retrieval_path: git clone and direct HTTPS fetch

reported_value.comparison: Coefficient to ARC versus ARC to METR

claim_atoms.text: The Schedule I line is reported by the ledger; the filing itself is not opened here.

results.uncertainty: The ARC transfer is an asset transfer at spin-out; its composition by original funder is not established.

results.proposition: The ledger's own audit states that the rendered figure's unqualified 'Direct: $0' is stronger than the record search can establish.
results.interpretation: The dataset behind the figure is more careful than the figure. Readers who take the figure's headline as a finding overstate what the rows support in either direction.
results.warrant: The audit file says so in its opening paragraph.
results.uncertainty: The audit is by the same author as the figure; it is candid but not independent.

counterevidence.evidence: Coefficient funded ARC in 2022 and ARC transferred $4.55M to METR at the 2024 spin-out.
counterevidence.qualification: Routing through a parent; share of the transfer attributable to Coefficient not established.

negative_results.scope: Coefficient Giving grants index, 2,911 rows, snapshot 2026-09-11, searched for METR under any name, as reported by the third-party ledger
negative_results.disposition: Retained as reported; not re-derived; absence not converted to zero.
